US proposes $70,000 fee for international student work permits

The U.S. administration is reportedly planning to charge international students a fee of $70,000 for work authorization after graduation. This proposed fee could impact U.S. colleges by imposing a significant financial burden related to international students seeking employment opportunities post-studies.
